name: [UPD 9] Bee Rich!  🍯
desc:
🐝 Welcome to Bee Rich! 🍯

Are you ready to build your very own buzzing bee farm? Gather honey, place hives, and grow your way to sweet success! Flex rare honey on friends and have fun!

EVENTS HAPPEN EVERY HOUR!

[How To Play]
• Gather honey using your dipper!
• Sell your honey at the market!
• Buy and place hives to make honey for you!
• Rebirth to unlock even more bees!

Experiencing lag? Get a private server or change your settings!

Remember, your bees literally collect offline! Bee-come a BEE-LLIONAIRE! 🐝
